description: Synthetic records of a fictional school district (Merrow Vale Unified), two fictional schools and one fictional family, for reproducible acceptance; not a benchmark task. fixtures/reference.json is the package seed: the 2026–27 school year is hand-authored, and the family's earlier history from 2025-01-01 (spring 2025 and the 2025–26 school year) is generated by scripts/history.cjs with a fixed seed. fixtures/minimal.json is the smaller account the business tests start from and has no generated history. Workflow shapes were informed by public product pages of ParentSquare (https://www.parentsquare.com/) and the PowerSchool parent portal (https://www.powerschool.com/); no data, text, branding or icons were taken from them.

sources.description: Hand-authored synthetic records of the 2026–27 school year and the minimal fixture; no external collection. Phone numbers use the fictional 555-01xx range.

The reference family's history from 2025-01-01 to the summer of 2026 (calendar-aware attendance exceptions and reports, forms and answers, a former pickup person and dismissal changes, lunch purchases, menus, top-ups, payments, year-end rollovers and notifications), generated deterministically at authoring time; no external collection and no generator at run time.

transformations: Timestamps carry explicit UTC offsets; school days and cut-offs are resolved in America/Los_Angeles.

Generated history: school-day records follow the district calendar of each year (scripts/history.cjs), and each year ends with a lunch-balance rollover that matches the hand-written carry-over of 2026-08-26.

Every record, hand-written or generated, obeys the App's rights, cut-off, collector and top-up rules, and every event the records imply has its notification in the App's wording (scripts/check-fixtures.cjs).

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism (policy values, school calendar, notification wording) and of the fictional status of the district and people.
